mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as long as rates remain below 0.25%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 4.0% signal a tight labor market that accelerates wage inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 600000 fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% and has risen for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth signals economic resilience, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth signals sustained economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: High CPI index levels above 270 signal persistent inflation, increasing the probability of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270 over a 3-year rolling window.
